stop.prompt:
You are enforcing Autoconnecto change management.

If this agent turn edited any workspace files (code, docs, config, swagger, training-videos, presentations, website, mobile, sdk), the agent's final reply MUST include a filled 'Change management' short checklist covering rows 1–15 (Frontend through Deploy) and a 'You (founder):' line.

If the checklist is present and complete enough (each row N/A or Updated/Deferred/founder action), respond with: {"followup_message": ""} or omit follow-up.

If the checklist is missing or clearly incomplete after a coding change, respond with a followup_message that tells the agent to paste the short checklist from CHANGE_MANAGEMENT.md now — do not redo the whole task, only add the checklist and founder actions.

Pure Q&A with no edits: no follow-up needed.

Hook input: $ARGUMENTS
